Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Professor Jasper Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url] mod Character Jasper Thomas (with Cameron), Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. (Cheekbone requested by lemurkat.)


*Make sure you have [b]PyTK[/b] mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Jasper mod (somewhere in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods folder[/b])
Drag the [b]"[CP] Jasper NPC"[/b] folder from my Zip to the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[NPC] Jasper\[CP] Jasper NPC[/b] folder to overwrite it.

This mod replaces the [b]"Airyn"[/b] portrait of Jasper. So if the portraits are not showing, please change Jasper's portrait to[b] Original[/b] in the config menu, or open your[b] config.json[/b] with a notepad and edit the[b] "JasperPortraits"[/b] line to [b]"JasperPortraits": "Airyn"[/b].


23/08/2021: Uploaded content Patcher version.
I would still recommend the replacement file version since the assets won't get loaded 2 times. But if the replacement file doesn't work for you, try this version.
31/10/2021: Updated the flower dance outfit portrait.


Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url]﻿ mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url]﻿﻿﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.

Downloads.Description:
Portraiture version.

*I do not advise using Portraiture to install those portraits since Portraiture doesn't support seasonal outfits, so their seasonal outfits and festival portraits will not work.*
If possible, please try the replacement file instead.

Content Patcher version, drag the folder into Stardew Valley\Mods to install.

I would still recommend the replacement file version since the assets won't get loaded 2 times. But if the replacement file don't work for you try this version.
